questions.question: According to the World Bank, what was Canada's GDP per capita in current US dollars in 2023?
headline: gdp_per_capita_2023_usd
questions.tolerance: ±0.5% (WDI vintage of the date recorded; WDI revises back years)
traps: Current US$, not constant 2015 US$ or PPP.
Not GDP per capita in Canadian dollars from Statistics Canada.
questions.why_kept: World Bank GDP per capita

questions.question: What was life expectancy at birth in Canada in 2025, according to the World Bank?

expected.behaviour: Decline: the WDI has no 2025 value for Canada's life expectancy at birth (SP.DYN.LE00.IN) as of 2026-10-08. The latest year is 2024; offering that figure, clearly labelled, is fine.

questions.tolerance: Pass only if no 2025 figure is given
traps: A Statistics Canada or UN projection is not a WDI value.
The 2024 value must not be passed off as 2025.
questions.why_kept: a 2025 World Bank value not published
